The Fieldkit Python SDK covers everything the dashboard does: devices, surveys, submissions, attachments and exports.

## Installation

```bash
pip install fieldkit
```

Python 3.9 or newer is required.

## Sync or Async

Every class comes in two flavours. They have the same methods with the same arguments; the async ones are coroutines.

<Tabs>
<TabItem label="Sync">
```python
from fieldkit import Fieldkit

fk = Fieldkit()
device = fk.devices.get("dev_01HZX4")
```
</TabItem>
<TabItem label="Async">
```python
from fieldkit import AsyncFieldkit

async with AsyncFieldkit() as fk:
    device = await fk.devices.get("dev_01HZX4")
```
</TabItem>
</Tabs>

## Reference

<CardGrid stagger>
    <Card title="Sync" icon="seti:python">
        `Fieldkit`, `Device`, `Survey` and `ObjectStorage`, for scripts and notebooks.
    </Card>
    <Card title="Async" icon="rocket">
        `AsyncFieldkit`, `AsyncDevice`, `AsyncSurvey` and `AsyncObjectStorage`, for services that already run an event loop.
    </Card>
</CardGrid>

Errors and shared types are common to both.

:::note
Callbacks are plain callables in both flavours — `on_token_refresh` takes a `Callable[[], str]` even on `AsyncFieldkit`. An async callback is not awaited.
:::
